_about: The repository every case is asked about (contract/evals/v1/protocol.md), built fresh per case in a new git repository: the tenant's declarations, a judge registry pointing at the runner's stub judge, and — per case — one dataset at the path its suite keeps. Outputs are fixed and carry the stub judge's markers: SCORE=, HALLUCINATION= and FAIRNESS= are what the stub answers with, so no model is called and no run drifts. The flagged hallucination dataset carries its context as {id, text} documents, the shape a retrieval layer produces; the clean one as strings.

files..agenticframework/tenant.yaml:
tenant:
  id: "fixture-tenant"
  name: "fixture-tenant"
  owner: owner@example.test

framework:
  version: "2.2.0"
files.models.yaml:
# The judge the conformance runner stands up: OpenAI-compatible, on loopback.
models:
  judge:
    id: stub-judge
    provider: openai
    endpoint: ${EVALS_STUB_JUDGE_URL}
    api_key_env: EVALS_STUB_JUDGE_KEY
